intent: Make a non-redundant protein set at 90% sequence identity from these assemblies' predicted proteins: every protein that is a (near-)identical copy or a truncated fragment of a longer protein should be absorbed into the cluster of that longer protein.
silent_error: mmseqs easy-cluster defaults to -c 0.8 with --cov-mode 0, which requires the alignment to cover at least 80% of BOTH the representative and the member. Fragments shorter than 80% of their parent therefore fail the coverage test and stay as singleton clusters even though they are 100% identical to part of a longer protein. The clustering exits 0 and writes a normal cluster table and representative FASTA that still contains the redundant partial copies; --cov-mode 1 (coverage of the member) merges fragments.
